softening_guidance.source_ref: ASEAN Appendix III, Section 3, final note
softening_guidance.text: Use cosmetic appearance or feel wording; modifiers do not validate prohibited mechanisms.
examples_from_source: Helps to remove oil from skin
Reduces the shine of oily skin
Makes your skin feel less oily

rules.title: Disease treatment or prevention
rules.description: same: no medicinal presentation.

rules.title: Permanent results
rules.description: same: effects ordinarily require continued use.

rules.title: Physiological modification
rules.description: HIGH unchanged; local examples additionally cover cellular mechanisms.

rules.title: Ageing reversal
rules.description: same: physiological ageing claims.

rules.title: Scar removal
rules.description: same.

rules.title: Acne treatment
rules.description: same for these moisturisers; assess permitted secondary claims separately.

rules.title: Body modification
rules.description: same: cellulite treatment, slimming, swelling or fat removal.

rules.title: Numbing
rules.description: same; temporary tingling is not automatically numbing.

rules.title: Fungicidal or virucidal action
rules.description: same; do not blanket-ban authorized antibacterial product categories.

rules.title: Unsupported vulnerable-user assurances
rules.description: same product policy; population targeting alone is not a blanket prohibition.

rules.title: Unapproved superlatives
rules.description: MEDIUM unchanged; law permits substantiated superlatives, brand remains stricter.

rules.title: Absolute safety
rules.description: Claims or implies freedom from side effects or harm, or safety because ingredients are natural. Excludes bounded, substantiated test results, cautions and denials.

rules.title: Medicine comparison
rules.description: MEDIUM unchanged for analogy; actual medicinal efficacy also triggers disease HIGH.

rules.title: Unapproved whitening
rules.description: same brand ban; not a blanket Malaysian whitening prohibition.

rules.title: Missing in-house qualifier
rules.description: same; exact spoken qualifier is brand policy.

rules.title: Uncertified halal representation
rules.description: Represents the product as halal without verified certification and required marking under paragraphs 4-5, through JAKIM/MAIN or a JAKIM-recognized foreign certifier. Ingredient exclusions alone are insufficient.

rules.title: Government approval claim
rules.description: Presenting the product as approved, endorsed or certified by the Ministry of Health (KKM/MOH) or NPRA. A notification number is not an approval.

rules.title: Improper competitor comparison
rules.description: Comparing the product with, or putting down, an identified competitor or brand, or claiming it is better than other products without evidence.

rules.title: Medical endorsement impression
rules.description: Implies individual healthcare-professional recommendation or endorsement. Permit verified objective professional surveys and professional-body endorsements with written consent. Do not infer endorsement from test supervision.

rules.title: Unsupported evidence
rules.description: Makes unsupported or misleading evidence claims; names test institutions without authorization; uses research for medicinal claims; or presents misleading before-and-after comparisons or omits elapsed time. Missing documentation requires verification.

rules.title: Invalid testimonial
rules.description: Uses a fabricated, obsolete or inapplicable testimonial, or misrepresents personal experience over a reasonable period. Unknown authenticity requires verification; omitting a variability disclaimer alone is not a violation.

rules.title: GMP promotional claim
rules.description: Promotes the product using the manufacturer's GMP certification or standard, including ISO 22716, even without claiming superior efficacy. Excludes denials.

rules.title: Religious efficacy claim
rules.description: Uses scripture or religious statements to promote the cosmetic. Excludes unrelated greetings and verified halal certification.
